interface.name: list_categories
interface.title: List Store Categories
interface.description: Returns a paginated list of the store's product categories, optionally filtered by a name keyword or by active/hidden status.
whenToUse: The merchant wants an overview of their store's category tree, e.g. 'what categories do I have?'.
The merchant asks whether a category with a certain name exists, e.g. 'do I have a shoes category?' -- filter with the keyword argument.
The merchant wants to review which categories are hidden from the storefront versus active -- filter with the status argument.
An agent needs a category id before acting on a category or filtering products by category.
whenNotToUse: The merchant named ONE specific category and wants its full details -- use get_category with the category id instead.
The merchant wants the products inside a category, not the categories themselves -- use list_category_products instead.

page.description: Pagination page number. The response returns one page of categories; increment to fetch the rest.

keyword.description: Filter categories to those whose name matches this keyword.

status.description: Filter categories by visibility status: 'active' (shown in the storefront) or 'hidden'.

id.description: The category id, used by sibling category and product tools.

parent_id.description: Id of the parent category; 0 for a top-level category.

sort_order.description: The category's position among its siblings.

image.description: URL of the category's image, if one is set.

components._comment: A contract annotation, kept here on purpose: the engine must strip it, because A2UI's catalog sets unevaluatedProperties false and would reject the message.

http.summary: List Categories -- list all categories related to your store, filterable by a keyword matching category names.

query.name: keyword
query.description: A keyword to filter categories by a specific name.

query.name: status
query.description: The status of the category, whether it is 'active' or 'hidden'.

statuses.meaning: The store's access token is missing or does not carry the categories.read scope, so the categories cannot be read until the app's authorization is fixed.
